Place of supply by province (telecommunication services: where the facility is ordinarily located or the billing address). Non-resident suppliers to consumers are assumed registered; B2B cross-border supplies are self-assessed by the recipient. https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/businesses/topics/gst-hst-businesses/charge-collect-which-rate.html

regimes.name: US state and local taxes on telecommunications
regimes.citation: State-level sales, gross receipts and communications taxes on telecommunications by state. Wireless service is sourced to the customer's place of primary use (Mobile Telecommunications Sourcing Act, 4 U.S.C. §§116-126). Internet access is exempt nationwide (Internet Tax Freedom Act). Local taxes are modelled for New York City, Chicago and Los Angeles only, and apply when the evidence names the city's jurisdiction; a place named only by its state bears state taxes alone. Other county, city and special-district taxes, 911 and other per-line fees, the federal USF and federal excise are not modelled, nor is the interstate/intrastate split of fixed-line charges. Seller collects; there is no reverse charge.
